briefdescription.para: Reads a single byte using I2C from a register.

detaileddescription.para: This function read a single byte over the I2C interface from a register and stores it in the provided reference variable.

parameterdescription.para: Reference to a variable where the read byte will be stored.

simplesect.para: Ensure that the device is correctly connected and that I2C communication is functioning. The function includes a loop with retries and delays to handle cases where the byte is not immediately available.

listitem.para: BSP_I2C_ERR_READ: Error reading from the I2C bus.
